subject.title: fix: stop node alerts replaying after Gateway restart

question: Should OpenClaw formally treat historical `client.instanceId` pairing aliases as unsupported orphan records and rely exclusively on canonical authenticated device IDs for connection-alert state?
rationale: The branch deliberately removes an old alias write and migration coverage now supports that interpretation, but the upgrade contract affects persisted pairing records and is protected by the `maintainer` label.

options.title: Confirm canonical-only pairing identity
options.body: Accept canonical authenticated device IDs as the only supported pairing identity, retain the alias-removal migration behavior, and merge after live after-fix proof is supplied.

options.title: Preserve an explicit legacy migration
options.body: Keep a narrowly scoped doctor or migration path for any released client-instance aliases that can be proven to map safely to a canonical paired device.

recommendation.title: Confirm canonical-only pairing identity
recommendation.body: Accept canonical authenticated device IDs as the only supported pairing identity, retain the alias-removal migration behavior, and merge after live after-fix proof is supplied.
